name: Transport and browser protection headers
objective: Check whether the approved origin sets the browser protections its responses depend on.
preconditions: The origin returns an HTML response
steps: Request the approved origin and capture the full response as evidence.
Record which of content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, referrer-policy, and strict-transport-security are absent.
Report one candidate naming the absent headers; do not report a candidate when every header is present.
falsePositives: An API that never returns HTML does not need frame protections.
A proxy in front of the origin may add headers that a direct request does not show.
